speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting. To help you, I need to ask you some questions: Is this the first time this has happened, or has it been going on for a few days? Has the baby passed any stool since the vomiting started, and if so, was it green?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with midgut volvulus.

The presentation of bilious vomiting within six hours of birth in a newborn, combined with the family history of pyloric stenosis, is highly suggestive of this life-threatening condition. Immediate surgical evaluation is required.
